articles.title_en: Empowering Adolescents to Transform Schools: Lessons from a Behavioral Targeting
articles.title_cn: 赋予青少年改造学校的能力：行为目标的经验教训
articles.abstract_en: We test the effectiveness of a behavioral program grounded in the idea that status granting and self-persuasion might yield a robust behavioral change in disadvantaged adolescents. We enlist socially connected senior middle school students with high emotional intelligence as "student-teachers" and entrust them with delivering a curriculum to their junior peers. The program empowers student-teachers, leading them to improve their social environment. It reduces disciplinary incidents and antisocial behavior among student-teachers and their friendship networks. The intervention significantly enhances the likelihood of admission to selective high schools for student-teachers, offering a cost-effective way to help disadvantaged adolescents escape neighborhood disadvantages.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们测试了一项行为计划的有效性，该计划的基础是地位授予和自我说服可能会给弱势青少年带来强有力的行为改变。我们招募具有高情商、有社会关系的高中生作为“学生教师”，并委托他们向低年级同学传授课程。该计划赋予学生教师权力，引导他们改善社会环境。它减少了师生及其友谊网络之间的纪律事件和反社会行为。该干预措施显着提高了学生教师进入精英高中的可能性，为帮助弱势青少年摆脱社区劣势提供了一种经济有效的方法。

articles.title_en: Regulating Conglomerates: Evidence from an Energy Conservation Program in China
articles.title_cn: 监管企业集团：来自中国节能计划的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study a prominent energy regulation affecting large Chinese manufacturers that are part of broader conglomerates. Using detailed firm-level data and difference-in-differences research designs, we show that regulated firms cut output and shifted some production to unregulated firms within their conglomerate instead of improving their energy efficiency. To account for conglomerate and market spillovers, we interpret these results through the lens of an industry equilibrium model featuring conglomerate production. The policy raises welfare if the per ton benefits of carbon reduction exceed $161. Alternative policies that exploit public information on business networks can increase aggregate energy savings by 10 percent.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一项影响大型中国制造商的重要能源法规，这些制造商是更广泛的企业集团的一部分。使用详细的企业级数据和双重差异研究设计，我们表明，受监管的企业削减产量并将部分生产转移到集团内不受监管的企业，而不是提高其能源效率。为了解释企业集团和市场溢出效应，我们通过以企业集团生产为特征的行业均衡模型来解释这些结果。如果每吨碳减排效益超过 $161，该政策就会提高福利。利用商业网络上的公共信息的替代政策可以增加 10% 的总体能源节省。

articles.title_en: A Theory of Dynamic Inflation Targets
articles.abstract_en: Should central banks' inflation targets remain set in stone? We study a dynamic mechanism design problem between a government and a central bank. The central bank has persistent private information about structural shocks. Firms learn the state from the central bank's reports and form inflation expectations. A dynamic inflation target implements the full-information commitment allocation. The central bank is delegated the authority to adjust the target's level and flexibility one period in advance. A declining natural interest rate and a flattening Phillips curve imply opposite optimal target adjustments. Our results speak to practical policy questions of inflation target design.
articles.abstract_cn: 央行的通胀目标是否应该保持不变？我们研究政府和中央银行之间的动态机制设计问题。央行拥有有关结构性冲击的持久私人信息。企业从央行的报告中了解状况并形成通胀预期。动态通胀目标实现了全信息承诺分配。央行被授权提前调整目标水平和灵活性一周期。自然利率下降和菲利普斯曲线趋平意味着相反的最优目标调整。我们的结果解决了通胀目标设计的实际政策问题。

articles.title_en: Sticky Wages on the Layoff Margin
articles.abstract_en: We design and field an innovative survey of unemployment insurance (UI) recipients that yields new insights about wage stickiness on the layoff margin. A majority of UI recipients would accept pay cuts of 5–10 percent to save their jobs, and one-third would accept a 25 percent cut. Yet worker-employer discussions about cuts in pay, benefits, or hours in lieu of layoffs are exceedingly rare. Roughly one-quarter of the layoffs in our sample violate the theoretical condition for bilaterally efficient separations. We draw on our findings and other evidence to assess theories of wage stickiness and its role in layoffs.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们设计并开展了一项针对失业保险 (UI) 领取者的创新调查，得出有关裁员幅度的工资粘性的新见解。大多数 UI 领取者会接受 5-10% 减薪以保住工作，而 一-第三 将接受 25% 减薪。然而，工人与雇主之间关于削减工资、福利或工作时间来代替裁员的讨论却极其罕见。我们样本中大约四分之一的裁员违反了双边有效离职的理论条件。我们利用我们的研究结果和其他证据来评估工资粘性理论及其在裁员中的作用。

articles.title_en: The Good Wife? Reputation Dynamics and Financial Decision-Making inside the Household
articles.title_cn: 贤妻良母？家庭内部的声誉动态和财务决策
articles.abstract_en: We study reputation dynamics within the household in a setting where women regularly receive transfers from their husbands for household purchases. We propose a signaling model in which wives try to maintain a good reputation in the eyes of their husbands to receive high transfers. This leads them to (i) avoid risky purchases (goods with unknown returns) and (ii) knowingly overuse low-return goods to hide bad purchase decisions—we call this the intrahousehold sunk cost effect. We present supportive evidence for the model from a series of experiments with married couples in rural Malawi.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究家庭内部的声誉动态，在这样的环境中，妇女经常从丈夫那里收到用于家庭购买的转账。我们提出了一种信号模型，在该模型中，妻子努力在丈夫眼中保持良好声誉，以获得高额转移。这导致他们（i）避免有风险的购买（回报未知的商品）和（ii）故意过度使用低回报商品来隐藏糟糕的购买决定——我们称之为家庭内沉没成本效应。我们通过对马拉维农村已婚夫妇进行的一系列实验，为该模型提供了支持证据。

articles.title_en: Hedging When Applying: Simultaneous Search with Correlation
articles.title_cn: 应用时的对冲：具有相关性的同时搜索
articles.abstract_en: Applicants to schools, colleges, and jobs hedge by applying to a broad range of options, including reaches, matches, and safeties. We develop a simultaneous-search framework that rationalizes this practice. In this framework, the admissions process is correlated across schools so that if an applicant is rejected by one school, she is more likely to be rejected by more selective schools. We find that an applicant then optimally targets both safeties and reaches. We characterize how the optimal portfolio varies with the applicant's beliefs, risk attitudes, and application costs and offer an algorithm that delivers the optimal portfolio in polynomial time.
articles.abstract_cn: 学校、大学和工作的申请者通过申请广泛的选择来对冲，包括范围、匹配和安全性。我们开发了一个同步搜索框架，使这种做法合理化。在此框架中，各学校的招生流程是相关的，因此，如果申请人被 一 学校拒绝，她更有可能被更具选择性的学校拒绝。我们发现申请人会以安全性和可达性为最佳目标。我们描述了最佳投资组合如何随申请人的信念、风险态度和申请成本而变化，并提供一种在多项式时间内提供最佳投资组合的算法。

articles.abstract_en: We study how to regulate a monopolistic firm using a robust-design, non-Bayesian approach. We derive a policy that minimizes the regulator's worst-case regret, where regret is the difference between the regulator's complete-information payoff and his realized payoff. When the regulator's payoff is consumers' surplus, he caps the firm's average revenue. When his payoff is the total surplus of both consumers and the firm, he offers a piece rate subsidy to the firm while capping the total subsidy. For intermediate cases, the regulator combines these three policy instruments to balance three goals: protecting consumers' surplus, mitigating underproduction, and limiting potential overproduction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究如何使用稳健设计的非贝叶斯方法来监管垄断公司。我们得出了一种政策，可以最大限度地减少监管者最坏情况的遗憾，其中遗憾是监管者的完整信息收益与其实现的收益之间的差异。当监管者的回报是消费者剩余时，他就会限制公司的平均收入。当他的收益是消费者和公司的总剩余时，他向公司提供计件工资补贴，同时限制补贴总额。对于中间情况，监管机构结合这些 三 政策工具来平衡 三 目标：保护消费者剩余、缓解生产不足以及限制潜在的生产过剩。

articles.title_en: Political Social Learning: Short-Term Memory and Cycles of Polarization
articles.title_cn: 政治社会学习：短期记忆和极化周期
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effect of voters' short-term memory on political outcomes by considering politics as a collective learning process. We find that short-term memory may lead to cycles of polarization and consensus across parties' platforms. Following periods of party consensus, short-term memory implies that there is little variation in voters' data and therefore limited information about the true state of the world. This in turn allows parties to further their own interests and hence polarize by offering different policies. In contrast, periods of polarization and turnover involve sufficient variation in the data that allows voters to be confident about what the correct policy is, forcing both parties to offer this policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过将政治视为集体学习过程来研究选民的短期记忆对政治结果的影响。我们发现短期记忆可能会导致各方平台之间的两极分化和共识循环。在政党达成共识之后，短期记忆意味着选民数据几乎没有变化，因此有关世界真实状况的信息有限。这反过来又使各方能够进一步促进自己的利益，从而通过提供不同的政策而两极分化。相比之下，两极分化和更替时期涉及数据的充分变化，使选民对正确的政策充满信心，迫使双方都提供这项政策。

articles.title_en: The Benefits of Revealing Race: Evidence from Minority-Owned Local Businesses
articles.title_cn: 揭露种族的好处：来自当地少数族裔企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: Is there latent demand to support Black-owned businesses? We explore this question by analyzing a new feature that made it easier to identify Black-owned restaurants on an online platform. We find that labeling restaurants as minority-owned increased customer engagement and firm performance, as measured by online traffic, calls, orders, and in-person visits. These effects were more pronounced in areas characterized by greater support for the Democratic Party and lower implicit bias against racial minorities. Labeled restaurants also see an increase in the fraction of reviews that are written by White customers.
articles.abstract_cn: 是否存在支持黑人企业的潜在需求？我们通过分析一项新功能来探讨这个问题，该功能可以更轻松地识别在线平台上的黑人拥有的餐馆。我们发现，通过在线流量、电话、订单和亲自拜访来衡量，将餐厅标记为少数族裔拥有的餐厅可以提高客户参与度和公司绩效。这些影响在对民主党支持较多、对少数族裔的隐性偏见较低的地区更为明显。带有标签的餐厅由白人顾客撰写的评论比例也有所增加。

articles.title_en: Start-up Costs and Market Power: Lessons from the Renewable Energy Transition
articles.title_cn: 启动成本和市场力量：可再生能源转型的经验教训
articles.abstract_en: Firms expect to recover the fixed costs required to start production by earning positive operating profits in subsequent periods. We develop a dynamic competitive benchmark that accounts for start-up costs, showing that static markups overstate the rents attributable to market power in an electricity market where generators frequently stop and start production in response to rooftop solar output. We demonstrate that the large-scale expansion of solar capacity can lead to increases in the collective profitability of fossil fuel plants because competition softens at sunset—plants displaced by solar during the day must incur start-up costs to compete in the evening.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业期望通过在后续时期赚取正营业利润来收回开始生产所需的固定成本。我们制定了一个动态竞争基准，该基准考虑了启动成本，表明静态加价夸大了电力市场中市场力量产生的租金，在该市场中，发电机经常根据屋顶太阳能输出而停止和启动生产。我们证明，太阳能发电能力的大规模扩张可以提高化石燃料发电厂的集体盈利能力，因为日落时竞争会减弱——白天被太阳能取代的发电厂必须承担启动成本才能在晚上进行竞争。
